description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the Converter class in the Goteo library, focusing on currency conversion rates, cache behavior, and use of mock objects.

classes.name: ConverterTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class testing the Converter class's currency rate retrieval and caching behavior.

methods.name: testInstance
methods.description: Creates an instance of the Converter class and sets up a mocked ConverterReader to return specific XML content.

methods.name: testGetRates
methods.description: Tests retrieval of currency exchange rates for EUR and verifies the presence of USD in the rates.

methods.name: testGetConverterEUR
methods.description: Tests the caching behavior for EUR rates, including cache retrieval and cache invalidation.

methods.name: testGetConverterUSD
methods.description: Tests retrieval of USD rates, cache behavior, and invalidation, using a mock reader for USD XML data.
